access_patterns.partition_key: none until single-node write ceiling is reached; account_id when partitioned

hotspot_analysis: Account ID is a potential hot key; serialize writes per account and monitor skew before partitioning.

decisions.choice: single relational ledger with indexed account_id
decisions.rationale: Workload and invariant fit one transactional boundary
decisions.tradeoff: less horizontal write scale but stronger atomicity
